text:
maria: Heads-up, opened a docs PR to clarify Dedicated autoscale edge-cases: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/842 — mainly SLA wording around eviction during maintenance and the `min_capacity` behaviour. Can reviewers skim? (cc @sam @anjali)

sam: looking now, will focus on the autoscale examples. flagged one incorrect SDK snippet.

maria: thx — the SLA paragraph currently says 'no evictions during SLA window' which is inaccurate if maintenance is scheduled. propose: 'no unplanned evictions; planned maintenance may result in brief evictions per customer-configured policies.'

anjali: agree. also add a note that Dedicated uses best-effort isolation; eviction due to CUDA OOM or host maintenance is allowed and will trigger automatic fallback. example suggestion below.

sam: found the broken snippet — Python SDK call in docs uses old arg `pool_size` instead of `capacity_pool`. Fix: 
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
client.create_capacity(name='team-prod', capacity_pool='c-1', autoscale_policy={'min':1,'max':8})
```

maria: nice catch. can you paste the Terraform block too? the current TF example also misses `eviction_policy`.

sam: sure:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_capacity" "team" {
  name           = "team-prod"
  gpu_type       = "A100"
  capacity_pool  = "c-1"
  autoscale {
    min = 1
    max = 8
    cooldown_seconds = 120
  }
  eviction_policy = "graceful" # options: graceful, immediate
}
```

anjali: add note: 'graceful' will try to drain and migrate KV cache; still can fail under host-level maintenance.

zack: minor: the migration guide link at bottom points to an internal/old path. should be https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/migration not /guides/migrate-dedicated. I'll open a small PR after this merges.

maria: docs-bot shows CI: lint OK, spellcheck flagged 'replication' -> 'replication/replicated' ambiguous. also proselint warning on SLA sentence length.

docs-bot: PR #842 checks: linter ✅, link-checker ❌ (broken link at line 142), unit-tests ✅

maria: who can fix link-checker? it's the migration link zack mentioned. @zack can you update before merge? Otherwise I'll stash the wording changes and merge the examples first.

zack: on it, will open 842.1 with the link fix in ~30m. :thumbsup:

sam: after link fix I'll push updated SDK snippets and TF block. can someone confirm we want to keep `eviction_policy` options as graceful/immediate? product?

maria: product approves 'graceful' default. add a short sentence under isolation that 'graceful' is the default unless customer sets immediate.

anjali: also recommend adding a troubleshooting blurb: how to detect eviction vs capacity scaling in logs: `eviction_reason` field in metrics => 'host_maintenance' or 'oom' or 'policy_preempt'.

maria: perfect. I'll update the PR content and merge once zack's link fix lands and sam's snippet commit is in.

zack: pushed link fix 842.1

sam: pushed snippets and TF block. all green locally, re-running CI.

docs-bot: PR #842.1 checks: linter ✅, link-checker ✅, unit-tests ✅, deploy-preview ✅

maria: merging now. thanks all! :tada:
